subject: CAIQ: implementation evidence liaison & staged delivery
messages:
From: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@acmecloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00Z
Subject: CAIQ controls - implementation evidence request

Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Acme Cloud's security review team is running a CAIQ-based verification and they'd like implementation-level artifacts for a small set of high-priority controls before we move to a broader exchange.

Controls of interest (examples): CCM-IMA-01 (identity lifecycle), CCM-LOG-03 (runtime telemetry), CCM-CRP-02 (cryptographic key management).

Can you provide:
- A mapping that ties each control to the Redwood implementation artifact (owner, artifact type, location).
- A sample of runtime telemetry that shows an authentication event and how the KV cache is recorded (redacted OK).
- An HSM/KEK attestation or diagram showing key separation and rotation cadence.

Attached: Acme_CAIQ_request_v2.pdf

Requesting delivery of an indexed bundle by 2026-09-10. Happy to accept a staged handoff if you need more time.

Thanks,
Lisa Ramos
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ controls - implementation evidence request

Lisa — thanks for the detail and attached PDF. Looping in the implementation leads so we can assemble a staged evidence bundle.

Proposed approach (brief):
1) Evidence liaison model: we name a single point of contact per control. That person will either upload artifacts to the shared Drive folder below or place them in the secure transfer (DocuSign/Box) if they contain secrets.
2) Staged delivery: Tier 1 (controls requested: IMA-01, LOG-03, CRP-02) by 2026-09-08; Tier 2 (remaining CAIQ) by 2026-09-17.
3) Redaction guidance: we'll provide redacted runtime logs and a short ingestion narrative that ties log fields to CAIQ assertions.

Ownership suggestions (we'll confirm):
- CCM-IMA-01: Priyom Das — identity lifecycle diagrams, SRP config, service-account provisioning runbook.
- CCM-LOG-03: Marcus Lin — telemetry excerpts, export scripts, sampling window description.
- CCM-CRP-02: Kimberly Park — key rotation evidence, KMS/HSM attestation PDF.

Drive (staging): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZ-Redwood-Acme-CAIQ

I've attached a worksheet with a starter mapping (caiq-initial-mapping.xlsx). Please confirm scope and whether Acme needs raw logs or summarized CSVs.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: caiq-initial-mapping.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T13:43:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ controls - implementation evidence request

Thanks, Olga. Quick note from the infra/runtime side on LOG-03 and IMA-01:

- For CCM-LOG-03: we can extract a 24-hour sample that includes auth success/failure and prefix cache hits. I'll redact IPs and user IDs; sample will include timestamps, request_id, model_id, cache_hit boolean, and truncated prompt hashes. Attached sample: runtime-telemetry-samples.log
- For CCM-IMA-01: identity lifecycle is captured across three places — IDP (Okta), service account provisioning (terraform state), and RBAC audits from the internal policy engine. I can produce a matrix mapping events to controls.

Blockers/asks:
- If Acme requires signed timestamps for telemetry, we'll need to coordinate with infra ops on the ingestion signing window (takes ~48 hours to schedule).
- Confirm whether a CSV summary is acceptable instead of raw log gzip.

I'll start filling the mapping sheet and will upload the telemetry sample to the Drive in a 'samples' subfolder.

Priyom
Priyom Das
Platform Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: runtime-telemetry-samples.log

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@acmecloud.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:17:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ controls - implementation evidence request

Lisa / team — adding notes on CCM-CRP-02 and key management evidence.

- We maintain KEKs in a hardware-backed HSM (AWS CloudHSM). I can provide the attestation PDF from our KMS provider and a short diagram showing the separation between tenant keys and platform master keys.
- Rotation cadence: platform master keys rotate quarterly; tenant KEKs rotate on request or during major upgrades. I'll redact ARN details where necessary.
- Redaction policy: we will never share private key material; we will share signed attestation PDFs and architecture diagrams.

Next steps: I'll upload the HSM attestation and a redaction checklist to the Drive by EOD.

Kimberly Park
Director, Cryptography & Key Management
Redwood Inference

Attachment: km-crypto-attestation.pdf

From: Lisa Ramos <lisa.ramos@acmecloud.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: CAIQ controls - implementation evidence request

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear plan.

A few clarifications before we accept the staged handoff:
1) For telemetry: summarized CSVs are acceptable for our first pass; we may request a signed sample later.
2) For key management: attestation PDFs + diagram suffice; we'll raise a follow-up if we need more granularity.
3) Please include a short mutual action plan (owner, deliverable, delivery date) in the Drive folder so our audit team can track commitments.

We can accept Tier 1 on 2026-09-08 as proposed. Please confirm by EOD tomorrow and we'll provision the reviewer access to the Drive.

Thanks,
Lisa Ramos
Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud

Attachment: none
